$note: 第 3 層 · 六十星系（2026-10-12）：天相獨坐丑未，《深造講義》p.84。

basis.quote: 必须注意其气质之优雅或庸俗

rules.text: 優雅的一面較重：命運未必勝過隨俗的人，社會地位卻較高。
rules.en: The refined side is stronger: your fortunes may not outrun those who follow the crowd, but your standing in society is higher.

rules.text: 隨俗的一面較重：社會地位或許不及氣質優雅的人，命運卻未必較差。
rules.en: The conforming side is stronger: your standing may not match those of refined temperament, but your fortunes aren't necessarily worse.

source.quote: 命运未必能及气质庸俗者

rules.text: 對宮的紫微破軍吉化，是天相遇明主之兆：你容易遇到賞識自己的上司。
rules.en: Zi Wei–Po Jun opposite you has a favourable transformation, a sign of Tian Xiang meeting a wise master: you tend to find superiors who value you.

rules.text: 對宮的紫微破軍見煞，你容易反覆，難免朝秦暮楚。
rules.en: Zi Wei–Po Jun opposite you meets malefics, so you're prone to changing sides, hard put to stay loyal to one camp.
